newsitem.title: USA: America Online in pact with CBS SportsLine.
newsitem.headline: America Online in pact with CBS SportsLine.

text.p: America Online Inc said Tuesday it has made a marketing deal with CBS SportsLine for an undisclosed amount.
As part of the deal, the more than eight million AOL members will have access to CBS SportsLine, an Internet sports service in which Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS owns a 22 percent equity stake.
In return, AOL will receive a payment as well as on-air promotion of AOL and integrated programming and promotion on the CBS SportsLine Website, with the AOL icon appearing on the site.
AOL also will get some of the CBS SportsLine merchandising revenues from AOL members.
A CBS SportsLine spokesman said the deal has a value in the "seven figures" but would not be more specific.

CBS SportsLine offers continually updated scores, statistics, analysis and live coverage of major events. It wll sponsor chat and other community activities on AOL and offer access to the personal Website of Michael Jordan, the basketball star.
AOL said the deal would make CBS SportsLine the first anchor tenant on the AOL Sports Channel.
